archetype: High-End Developer Tools / Swiss Brutalist Dark (Archetype 4/5 blend)

spacing_and_layout.dashboard_grid: Control Room Grid (Dense, gap-4 to gap-6, rigid constraints)

ui_elements.cards: Flat background (#111111), 1px solid border (#1E1E1E), no heavy drop shadows, soft ambient inner glow on hover
ui_elements.buttons: Primary: Solid #00C896 with black text or glowing gradient border. Secondary: transparent with 1px border. Hover states: slight lift, brighter border.
ui_elements.borders: Always 1px. Never use thick borders. Use Tailwind class border-[#1E1E1E].

animations.hover: Subtle border color shifts, 0.2s ease, micro-lift (-translate-y-1)
animations.charts: Smooth drawing animations, glow on active data points
animations.page: Fade in, staggered entrance for grid items

hero_backgrounds.description: Minimalist dark abstract background with soft glowing neon lines (use in Hero section or login screen)
Dark gradient texture for AI insights panel backgrounds

component_instructions.navigation: Minimal sidebar layout. Do not crowd the header. Active states get a subtle glowing left-border or background tint.
component_instructions.charts: Use Recharts with dark mode styling. Hide grid lines or make them very faint (#1E1E1E). Use primary accent (#00C896) for main data lines with a drop-shadow glow.
component_instructions.data_display: Always use tabular-nums class for metrics/balances. Positive numbers in #00C896, neutral in text-primary, warnings/alerts in #8B5CF6 or red if severe.
component_instructions.testing: All interactive elements MUST include a data-testid attribute in kebab-case.

specific_page_rules.dashboard: AI Financial Command Center. Replace 'Add Income' with 'New Revenue' and 'Record Expense'. Highlight AI Insights with the glow_gradient border or subtle background texture.
specific_page_rules.landing_page: High visual impact. Use the hero_background image. Bold headlines (Clash Display/Satoshi). Overlapping bento layouts. Dark gradient overlays to ensure text readability.
